text:
lia: Quick heads-up — quantized reranker (ranger-3B-ptq) shows an unexpected NDCG@10 drop vs FP32 baseline. posting numbers and thoughts below.

maria: how big are we talking?

lia: FP32 baseline ndcg@10 = 0.421
lia: PTQ int8 ndcg@10 = 0.403  (≈ -4.3%)
lia: MRR FP32 = 0.347, PTQ = 0.344 (≈ -0.9%)
lia: bootstrap(1000) delta CI for ndcg: [-0.028, -0.012] so looks significant. :thinking_face:

zach: did you try different query/doc formatting? we saw formatting artifacts skew reranker scores before.

lia: yep. quick summary:
- keep_title=true, doc_trunc=512 -> ndcg 0.403
- keep_title=false, concat-title-to-query -> ndcg 0.409
so formatting shifts are on the order of the observed drop.

kevin: can you paste the eval command you ran? want to reproduce.

lia: sure — this is the exact command I used:

```
python eval/rerank_eval.py \
  --pred preds/ranger3b_ptq_scores.json \
  --qrels data/msmarco_dev_qrels.tsv \
  --queries data/msmarco_dev_queries.json \
  --metrics ndcg@10,mrr \
  --bootstrap 1000 \
  --doc-format keep_title=true,doc_trunc=512
```

maria: how many queries in the dev split here? slices?

lia: full dev = 6,000 queries.
lia: long-query slice (~500 q) shows bigger variance and CI overlapping zero.

zach: could be quant backend sensitivity (awq vs GPTQ vs PTQ). which one?

lia: this run used our default PTQ pipeline using FakeQuant in the converter (per-channel asymmetric).
lia: quick check: AWQ-style quantization (8-bit grouped) gave ndcg 0.408.

eval-bot: New eval run finished: 1891240005 — ranger3b_ptq_awq variant — ndcg@10 0.408, MRR 0.345. Link: https://redwood.internal/evals/1891240005 :white_check_mark:

kevin: interesting. have we tried per-layer fp32 fallback? earlier layers often hurt more.

lia: tried fp32 MLP only (keep attn quantized) -> ndcg 0.417. almost back to baseline. suggests MLP kernels particularly fragile.

maria: could also be doc truncation interacting with quantized KV cache precision. any difference when increasing context?

lia: bumped doc_trunc to 1024 -> small improvement (0.406). not full recovery.

zach: action plan:
- run per-layer fallback (first 2 MLPs)
- try AWQ + per-channel scale calibration
- re-eval with concat-title-to-query and without title
- increase bootstrap to 5000 for small slices

lia: I'll run those and post results. aiming to finish by EOD.

maria: also add a paired t-test and permutation test for the global set (complement bootstrap). we want multiple lenses.

lia: noted. one more thing — logging showed weird softmax underflow on some examples when quantized (softmax outputs clipped). snippet:

```
WARN: softmax underflow at layer 9, sample id 4212 -> all probs ~1e-7, renorm applied
```

kevin: yikes. please capture the offending examples and put in /tmp/quant-investigation.zip.

lia: will do. attaching initial failing ids in the thread: [4212, 1421, 998, 3045].

zach: thanks. if MLP fallback fixes most of it we can ship a conservative per-layer fallback policy for Dedicated customers.

lia: ok will run per-layer + awq + bigger bootstrap and report back here. :thumbsup:

maria: great. ping me if you need extra slices or help with stats scripts.

lia: thanks all. updating ticket INF-8470 with the investigation notes and next steps. :clipboard:
